title: Bohol board member seeks probe into Balicasag tour guide fees

blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol– A Bohol provincial board member wants an inquiry into the collection of environmental or entrance fees from Department of Tourism (DOT)-accredited tour guides accompanying visitors to Balicasag Island in Panglao town, citing the need for clear, consistent policies across the province’s tourism destinations. Lawyer Jiselle Rae Aumentado Villamor, chairperson of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan’s Committee on Tourism, raised the issue in a privilege speech on Tuesday, asking the provincial government to determine the legal basis for the fees, the authority responsible for collecting them, and whether tour guides are subjected to the charges.
